summary: Straight-line session/UI/input dispatch chain: sets a session type flag via sub_42D210, creates a UI element with id 30 through a vtable slot on this[16], activates it via sub_46BF10, calls the input/force-feedback helper sub_4D2450 with dword_8ACEE0, then invokes a vtable callback at slot 14 on this with parameter 1.

local_names.v2: UI object returned by the vtable slot call

operations.description: Set the session type flag: call sub_42D210 on dword_7C569C by reference with value 1
Call the vtable slot at 0x1C of the object at this[16] with id 30 to obtain a UI element object
Activate the obtained UI object by calling sub_46BF10 with parameter 1
Call the input/force-feedback helper sub_4D2450 passing the global dword_8ACEE0
Invoke the vtable callback at slot 14 (byte offset 0x38) on the this object vtable with parameter 1

unresolved: The concrete type of the this object and of the UI object returned by the vtable slot call is unknown.
Semantics of dword_7C569C beyond a session-type flag and of dword_8ACEE0 beyond an input/force-feedback base are not confirmed.
